mapper.select: /** [sql-warehousing.xml] WarehousingMapper.getWarehousingList **/ SELECT B.*, C.ST02_PNO, NVL2(QA05.QA05_AVAILABLE, 'S', 'W') AS ST02_STATUS, QA05.QA05_AVAILABLE FROM ( SELECT A.*, B.CM01_NAME AS PU01_CUS_NM, D.CM08_CODE, D.CM08_NAME FROM ( SELECT PU01_COMPANY, PU01_FACTORY, PU01_NO, PU01_REV, PU01_CUS, PU01_DAT, MAX(PU02_CODE) AS PU02_CODE , MIN(C.PU02_WANYN) AS PU01_WANYN FROM TB_PU_01 A LEFT JOIN TB_PU_02 C ON C.PU02_COMPANY = A.PU01_COMPANY AND C.PU02_FACTORY = A.PU01_FACTORY AND C.PU02_HNO = A.PU01_NO WHERE 1 = 1 AND PU01_NO = '20250228002' AND PU01_CUS = '0002' GROUP BY PU01_COMPANY, PU01_FACTORY, PU01_NO, PU01_REV, PU01_CUS, PU01_DAT ) A LEFT JOIN TB_CM_01 B ON A.PU01_CUS = B.CM01_CODE AND A.PU01_COMPANY = B.CM01_COMPANY AND A.PU01_FACTORY = B.CM01_FACTORY LEFT JOIN TB_CM_08 D ON D.CM08_COMPANY = A.PU01_COMPANY AND D.CM08_FACTORY = A.PU01_FACTORY AND D.CM08_CODE = A.PU02_CODE ) B LEFT JOIN (SELECT ST02_PNO FROM TB_ST_02 WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY ST02_PNO) C ON C.ST02_PNO = B.PU01_NO LEFT JOIN TB_QA_05 QA05 ON QA05.QA05_COMPANY = B.PU01_COMPANY AND QA05.QA05_FACTORY = B.PU01_FACTORY AND QA05.QA05_CODE = B.PU02_CODE AND QA05.QA05_SDT <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND QA05.QA05_EDT >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') WHERE 1=1 AND ST02_PNO IS NULL ORDER BY PU01_DAT DESC, PU01_NO
select mat_code from tb_material where mat_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{code},'%') group by mat_code order by mat_code
